title: Case-crossover design by conditional logistic regression
summary: A transient exposure's effect on an acute event, comparing each case's hazard window with their own referent windows.

sizing._why: Case-crossover power depends on the exposure prevalence and the number of referent windows (a matched-set calculation); no catalog form takes them, and the matched case-control rule forbids borrowing the paired form.

pinned_defaults: Both: conditional logistic regression stratified on the patient; one hazard window and three time-stratified referent windows.
R: clogit(method = 'exact') (the default is an approximation passed through coxph).
Python: ConditionalLogit with method = 'newton'. The default (BFGS) stopped 5.4e-5 short of the maximum on this fixture, even with gtol = 1e-10; Newton reaches the exact conditional MLE.
_design: Each patient is their own control, so everything fixed over the windows is removed. Suits transient exposures with acute effects; time trends in exposure within a stratum still bias it.
